title: Send the board financial report
summary: Generate monthly board update with financial metrics, burn rate, runway, and key KPIs.

parts.title: Pull bank balances
parts.guidance: Take a cash snapshot across the company’s accounts at one reporting cut-off. Separate available cash from restricted funds, investments and pending transfers, avoiding double counting of internal transfers. State currencies and the conversion basis for any consolidated total. Reconcile significant changes since the previous board report so the runway calculation starts from an explainable cash figure.

execution.rationale: Mercury account balances support a dated cash snapshot, with supplied restrictions and currency assumptions reconciled separately.

parts.title: Pull revenue from Stripe
parts.guidance: Pull processor activity for the reporting period, separating charges, refunds, disputes, fees and payouts. Reconcile it to the board’s revenue definition: collections, invoiced amounts and recognized revenue may differ. Use consistent currencies, time zones and comparison periods, and explain adjustments or unmatched amounts before the extract feeds the report.

execution.rationale: Stripe balance transactions expose processor movements for reconciling the period's charges, refunds, fees and payouts.

parts.title: Pull expenses from QBO
parts.guidance: Pull expenses for the board period from the accounting system, checking entity, accounting basis and close status. Separate recurring operating costs from transfers, financing and unusual items in the analysis. Tie material categories to the ledger and show management adjustments alongside the original total so the founder can explain spending changes accurately.

execution.rationale: QuickBooks' report interface supplies period expense detail for the board analysis.

parts.title: Calculate burn rate and runway
parts.guidance: Calculate operating cash burn for a stated period, showing one-time items separately. Reconcile usable cash to the balance schedule and model how hiring, collections and committed spending affect future cash. Show a downside case where useful. If the company is generating cash, explain that a simple cash-divided-by-burn ratio does not provide a meaningful runway estimate.

execution.rationale: Compute burn and runway scenarios from reconciled cash and spending schedules using the repository's calculation module.

parts.title: Compile board report draft
parts.guidance: Draft the board report around cash, performance against plan, runway and material financial risks. Link figures to the closed accounts or label them provisional. Explain the largest variances in business terms and distinguish actual results from forecasts. Highlight decisions or support needed from directors so the founder can review both the numbers and the discussion they should support.

execution.rationale: Draft the board financial narrative and variance analysis from the supplied accounts and forecast.

parts.title: Founder reviews and edits
parts.guidance: Review the draft’s explanation of revenue, spending and runway against the financial schedules and current strategy. Resolve inconsistent numbers with finance and make forecast assumptions explicit. Decide which sensitive details belong in the main report or restricted appendices, then settle the final version for directors with any material uncertainty clearly described.

execution.rationale: The founder edits the Notion board-report draft produced in the preceding step. Notion's shared editing and comments support resolving figures with finance and settling disclosures; the founder remains responsible for the strategy and final narrative.

parts.title: Send to board members
parts.guidance: Send the final report through the company’s board distribution channel to the current authorized directors and observers. The designated company sender checks access to the report and restricted appendices before distribution. Include the meeting context and any requested preparation, and resolve individual access failures without opening the wider data room.

execution.rationale: Gmail's send operation supports distributing the approved board report to the verified recipient list.

metadata.supportReason: All data sources (Mercury, QBO, Stripe) have APIs. System compiles metrics, calculates burn/runway, formats report.
